tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a zero-middleman-fee UnFee payment short link (/to/<wallet>/<amount>/<currency>), hosted checkout URL, dynamic OpenGraph social preview card, scannable SVG QR code, and 1-line HTML embed snippet for Base (USDC, ETH, cbBTC, EURC) or XRPL (XRP, RLUSD).

tools.name: get_instant_free_rpc_key
tools.description: Mint a live UnFee API key with Free Tier credits (flat 1 request = 1 credit across eth_call, eth_getLogs, and XRPL JSON-RPC; 0 compute-unit multipliers).

tools.name: compare_payment_fees
tools.description: Compare legacy card processor fees (2.9% + $0.30) against UnFee Starter ($0/mo, 0.005% = 5¢ per $1,000 micro-fee) and UnFee Indie ($5/mo, True 0% protocol fee).

tools.name: get_live_arb_opportunities
tools.description: Scan all 9 live Base Mainnet 3-hop triangular flash-loan arbitrage loops (cbXRP, AERO, EURC, cbBTC, VIRTUAL, BRETT, DEGEN, MORPHO, WELL) and XRPL CLOB spreads.

tools.name: verify_transaction
tools.description: Verify an on-chain Base Mainnet or XRPL transaction hash and return settlement confirmation details.

tools.name: unfee_check_seller_reputation
tools.description: Check a seller or x402 API provider on-chain/gateway Proof-of-Delivery reputation (verified HTTP-200 deliveries, dropped failed calls, delivery rate %, and buyer USD saved on failed calls).

tools.name: unfee_pay_with_delivery_proof
tools.description: Execute an atomic HTTP-200 Proof-of-Delivery x402 settlement check: settles payment ONLY if the seller returns HTTP 200..299 with a valid non-empty payload and matching SHA-256 digest; drops authorization with $0.00 buyer charge if upstream fails.

tools.name: unfee_generate_tax_report
tools.description: Generate an instant IRS Form 8949, Schedule D summary, FIFO/HIFO/LIFO cost-basis calculation, non-taxable self-transfer reconciliation, and TurboTax / QuickBooks CSV export for any Base (0x...) or XRPL (r...) wallet at $0.01 via x402 (or $0 on $5/mo Indie Tier), undercutting Koinly and CoinTracker b

tools.name: base_rpc_request
tools.description: Execute any Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) JSON-RPC method (eth_call, eth_getLogs, eth_getBalance, eth_estimateGas, eth_sendRawTransaction, eth_blockNumber) at a flat 1 Request = 1 Credit (250,000 free calls/month, zero compute-unit multipliers).

tools.name: eth_getLogs_flat_rate
tools.description: Query Base Mainnet (8453) or Ethereum Mainnet (1) eth_getLogs event logs at 1 flat credit per request (saving 75x–500x vs. legacy compute-unit RPC gateways that charge 75–500 CUs per eth_getLogs call).

tools.name: xrpl_rpc_request
tools.description: Execute any native XRP Ledger (XRPL Mainnet) JSON-RPC method (account_info, book_offers, server_info, tx, submit, account_lines) at 1 flat credit per request with zero compute-unit markups.

tools.name: ethereum_rpc_request
tools.description: Execute any Ethereum Mainnet (Chain ID 1) JSON-RPC method (eth_call, eth_getLogs, eth_getBalance, eth_blockNumber, eth_estimateGas) at 1 flat credit per request (250,000 free calls/month).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "unfee_pay_with_delivery_proof" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
